# Native source-clause preparation diagnostic

This scratch workflow selects original source clauses instead of top-level
conjuncts at the existing local exit-lowering boundary. The same canonical
lowering supplies preparation and checked pieces, in original clause order.
Selected names bound the experiment; they are not a proposed product policy.

Unchanged controls must reproduce the current native query and resource vectors.
The existing strict typed lexical-binder fingerprint records every actual check,
with attributes, ground terms, triggers, fuel and guards retained. False-entry
controls remain genuinely Invalid. The frontend adds only that negative control
after translation and audits retained command and branch-transfer identities.
Normal product workflows do not enable this diagnostic. This compilation and
focused comparison provide no product or whole-suite acceptance.
